title: POLY PMNA Android app 3.13
message: Install this signed release update to refresh the WebView security client and keep receiving future app updates from the homepage.
releaseNotes: Signed public release APK for Android installs and upgrades.
Refreshes the WebView cache once on APK version change so the current security-hardened website client is loaded.
New lesson push notifications through Firebase Cloud Messaging.
Homepage Download Our App button points to this GitHub Release APK.
Revision 2026 and Revision 2021 remain separate content destinations.
